name: Koli Catch
subtitle: Fresh Seafood App Installs & User Acquisition
campaign: App User Acquisition & Repeat Order Growth
challenge: Consumers held deep reservations about ordering fresh fish and prawns online due to freshness, hygiene, and ice-packing doubts. The challenge was building rock-solid cold-chain credibility while scaling daily mobile app installs across Mumbai and Thane at an efficient CPI.
approach: Produced unscripted dock-to-doorline process videos highlighting zero-chemical, ozone-cleaned, cold-chain handling.
Launched live harbor arrival videos showing live Vashi mud crabs and morning catch arrivals to spark organic food enthusiasm.
Engineered transparent daily rate-card offer ads (e.g. Surmai Slices at ₹950) that eliminated price ambiguity for home chefs.
Ran high-visibility video placements on JioHotstar during live evening sports broadcasts targeting Mumbai food lovers.
Optimized Google Universal App Campaigns (UAC) with automated bidding focused on first in-app purchase conversion.
result: Acquired 18,400+ verified app installs at an optimised CPI of ₹18 (slashed from ₹34 baseline), reaching 485,000 unique households in Mumbai with strong repeat purchase frequency.

strategies.title: 01 DOCK-TO-DOOR FRESHNESS PROCESS REEL
strategies.description: Captured unscripted harbor cleaning, temperature checks, and vacuum-sealed packaging to eliminate doubts about online seafood freshness.

strategies.title: 02 LIVE VASHI CRAB ARRIVAL VIDEO
strategies.description: Filmed live mud crab unloading and grading at the Vashi distribution hub, driving viral shareability across WhatsApp and Instagram foodie groups.

strategies.title: 03 SURMAI SLICE DAILY RATE OFFER AD
strategies.description: Designed transparent rate-card pricing creatives matching local fish market rates with free doorstep delivery, driving immediate first app orders.

strategies.title: 04 FROZEN SNACKS READY-TO-COOK VIDEO
strategies.description: Targeted evening dinner planning with crisp, ready-to-fry prawn bites and fish cutlets, expanding the customer base beyond traditional raw fish buyers.

strategies.title: 05 SASHIMI-GRADE VASHI RAWAS SHOWCASE
strategies.description: High-detail macro product photography highlighting pink, freshly cut Indian Salmon (Rawas), driving premium high-ticket seafood basket sizes.

timeline.title: HYGIENE FOOTAGE HARVEST
timeline.description: Filming the harbor arrival, ice-slurry chilling, and automated slicing facilities to build trust assets.

timeline.description: Setting up deep-linking into app categories (Fish, Prawns, Ready-to-cook) for immediate purchase flow.

timeline.title: RATE CARD TESTING
timeline.description: A/B testing daily price rate cards against generic branding to trigger high install-to-order velocity.

timeline.title: HOTSTAR CAMPAIGN RUN
timeline.description: Running high-energy video spots during evening match schedules to capture peak dinner intent.

timeline.title: CPI OPTIMIZATION
timeline.description: Refining audience demographics to reduce blended CPI from ₹34 down to ₹18.

keyLearnings: Showing direct unscripted harbor unloading footage reduced customer acquisition cost by 47% by resolving freshness doubts instantly.
Transparent daily price headlines (e.g. Surmai Slices at ₹950) generated 2.4x higher install-to-order conversion than discount voucher angles.
JioHotstar video ads delivered strong local brand awareness with exceptional recall across Mumbai neighborhoods.
Google App Campaigns focused on in-app purchase events delivered a 44% first-order activation rate.
